name: flow-learning-system
description: Write lessons as JSON and build motion-graphics textbooks with sentence-synced TTS, for any subject.
long_description: One sentence = one scene. An AI writes lesson JSON; this server validates it, runs example code, renders 3D figures with Blender (with projected hotspots), synthesizes Korean/English narration with Supertonic and per-sentence timing, and builds a single-file HTML player whose graphs, equations, word tiles, images and code move exactly when the voice reaches each sentence. Optional: pip extra [tts] for audio, Blender for render_3d, Mono/.NET for C# verification.
